result.instructions: Tools for bexio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which sales invoices are still open, and which of them are overdue?"; "Which supplier bills are due this month, and how much is still to pay?"; "Show last month's journal bookings on the bank account.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes bexio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bexio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bexio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bexio_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. bexio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bexio_get_company_profile
tools.title: Get company profile
tools.description: The bexio company's profile: name, address, legal form, VAT (MWST) and UID numbers, contact details. Each bexio account has one profile.

tools.name: bexio_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: The signed-in bexio user (id, name, email, superadmin/accountant flags). Its id is the default user_id of new records.

tools.name: bexio_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: The company's bexio users (id, name, email). Use an id as user_id or owner of contacts, documents and timesheets.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: bexio_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List or search contacts (customers, suppliers, persons, companies). Without filters it pages through all contacts; with filters it uses bexio's contact search (all filters must match). name_1 is the company name or a person's last name, name_2 a person's first name.

name.description: name_1 (company name or last name) contains this text.

first_name.description: name_2 (a person's first name or a company's name addition) contains this text.

updated_since.description: Changed on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

archived.description: true = archived contacts only (default: active contacts).

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: bexio_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact with its address, emails, phones, language, groups and remarks.

archived.description: true when the contact is archived.

status.description: Only invoices with one of these statuses.

contact_id.description: Only documents for this contact (from bexio_list_contacts).

user_id.description: Only documents owned by this bexio user (from bexio_list_users).

document_nr.description: Document number contains this text (e.g. RE-00012).

valid_from_after.description: Document date (is_valid_from) on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

valid_from_before.description: Document date (is_valid_from) on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

updated_since.description: Changed on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: bexio_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a new contact (company or person) in bexio. Nothing existing is changed. For a person, name is the last name and first_name the first name. Owner and responsible user default to the signed-in user.

name.description: Company name, or a person's last name (name_1).

first_name.description: A person's first name, or a company's name addition (name_2).

country_id.description: bexio country id (1 = Switzerland in a default bexio setup).

language_id.description: bexio language id of the contact's correspondence language.

user_id.description: Responsible bexio user (default: the signed-in user).

owner_id.description: Owner bexio user (default: the responsible user).

tools.name: bexio_create_note
tools.title: Create note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note (call log, meeting minutes, follow-up) to a contact and/or project in bexio. Nothing existing is changed.

event_start.description: When it happened, local time yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM[:SS] (default: now, UTC).

user_id.description: Author bexio user (default: the signed-in user).

tools.name: bexio_create_timesheet
tools.title: Create timesheet entry
tools.description: WRITE: log time in bexio: either date + duration (HH:MM), or start + end. Needs a business activity (bexio_list_business_activities). Nothing existing is changed.

duration.description: Time worked as HH:MM, e.g. 01:30 (with date).

start.description: Start, local time yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM[:SS] (with end).

end.description: End, local time yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM[:SS] (with start).

status_id.description: Timesheet status id (bexio's default when omitted).

tools.name: bexio_create_draft_invoice
tools.title: Create draft invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create a DRAFT invoice in bexio for a contact, with custom, item (article) and text lines. It is never issued, sent or booked: the user reviews and issues it in bexio. Taxes must be active sales taxes (bexio_list_taxes with types sales_tax, scope active).

type.description: custom = a free line (text, amount, unit_price, tax_id); article = an existing item (article_id, amount, tax_id); text = a text-only line.

text.description: Line text (required for custom and text lines; for article lines the item's text is used when omitted).

amount.description: Quantity (max. 6 decimals). Required for custom and article lines.

unit_price.description: Price per unit (max. 6 decimals). Required for custom lines; article lines default to the item's price.

tax_id.description: An ACTIVE sales tax (bexio_list_taxes with types sales_tax, scope active). Required for custom and article lines.

article_id.description: The item (from bexio_list_articles). Required for article lines only.

account_id.description: Revenue account (from bexio_list_accounts); bexio's default when omitted.

unit_id.description: Unit id (bexio's units, e.g. hours); none when omitted.

document_nr.description: Invoice number. Only when automatic numbering is OFF in bexio's settings (then it is required); leave empty with automatic numbering.

contact_sub_id.description: A contact person of the customer.

valid_to.description: Due date, yyyy-mm-dd (default from the payment terms).

tax_mode.description: net = unit prices are net and VAT is added (default); gross = unit prices include VAT; exempt = the invoice is exempt from VAT.

currency_id.description: Currency (from bexio_list_currencies); company default when omitted.

bank_account_id.description: Bank account for the payment slip (from bexio_list_bank_accounts); default when omitted.

language_id.description: Document language id; the contact's language when omitted.

payment_type_id.description: Payment type id; default when omitted.

reference.description: Customer reference shown on the invoice.

api_reference.description: Your own external reference (only visible through the API).

user_id.description: Responsible bexio user (default: the signed-in user).
